wontFixReason: Documented engine gap (Tier B follow-up): award multiplier under-lifts at T5 when applicant has sub-median academics. USAMO national-tier recognition does not currently compensate enough for GPA 3.75 + SAT 1500. Fixture is preserved to track when engine fix lands.
